name: Tracker’s Gift
body:
School divination; Level inquisitor 1, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a bit of cloth)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 24 hours

DESCRIPTION

Your eyes grow glassy for a moment and then clear into a sharp focus. While this spell is active you may roll any Survival check made to follow a trail twice and take the better result.
